subject: Initial MAP draft — please validate stakeholders & proposed close target
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Grace Li <grace.li@novustech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP draft — please validate stakeholders & proposed close target

Hi Grace — great conversation yesterday, thanks for the time. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the minimal milestones we recommend to get you from POC to production with the least risk. Key items in the doc:

- Milestones (with suggested owners and tentative dates):
  • Kickoff & scoping (NovusTech: Emily Park) — week of 5/26
  • Integration spike (SSO, test data flow) — week of 6/2
  • Pilot run (2-week pilot, 1 customer) — 6/16–6/30
  • Security checklist & signoff (NovusTech Security / Redwood SME) — by 7/7
  • Billing & procurement sign-off — target close 7/18 or 8/8 (two timeline options)

- Dependencies: SSO config, legal review window, and a small pilot dataset from NovusTech.
- Risk: procurement windows (we highlighted two close targets depending on procurement lead time).

Ask: can you confirm the internal stakeholder roster (names/emails) and which target close date you prefer (7/18 — aggressive, or 8/8 — conservative)? If you want, we can also add a 1-day executive review step after the security signoff.

I'm cc'ing Lauren who will support kickoff logistics and Aditya for technical validation. Attached: NovusTech_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft) and discovery-notes-20250517.txt.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

- Stakeholders:

  • Marcus Chen — Security reviewer (mchen@novustech.com)
  • Procurement (procurement@novustech.com) — will coordinate contract terms

- Timeline: the 8/8 close target is more realistic for us given our Procurement cycles, but we could aim for 7/18 if legal expedites the review.
- Dependencies: we'll need a short XLS with token expectations for billing (I can get that from Analytics) and confirmation of data residency options.

Next steps from NovusTech: I'll confirm internal availability for week-of-5/26 kickoff and ask Marcus to review the security checklist in the MAP. Can you add a line item for a 2-day SSO window for our infra team?

Appreciate it — Grace

Thanks both — quick operational asks from my side after reading the MAP:

1) Add an explicit "Integration Spike" milestone (owner: Aditya Rao) for SSO + sample dataset intake; make that a deliverable with clear acceptance criteria (SSO test users + sample ingest success).
2) Insert a short "Data Residency/Compliance checklist" item before security signoff so NovusTech knows what evidence we need.
3) Procurement notes: if NovusTech expects any non-standard contract language we should get a heads-up this week — procurement cycles typically add 4–6 weeks.

Proposed slight timeline tweak: move Pilot run to begin 6/23 (gives 1 week buffer after spike). That keeps the conservative close of 8/8 intact while making 7/18 unlikely unless procurement moves very fast.

I'll update the MAP and re-send a v1.1 with the items above and a simple responsibility table. Aditya — can you confirm the technical acceptance criteria for the spike (SSO success + sample ingest success)?

-Lauren

- Integration spike (owner: Aditya Rao) — acceptance: SSO test users (3) + successful ingest of sample dataset (pass/fail)
- Pilot moved to 6/23–7/7 to give buffer for the spike
- Close target: 8/8 (conservative path) — marked as default unless Procurement says otherwise
